name: Load module
description: Loads an adapter module jar into the running venue. Its adapters and catalog declarations overwrite existing names and paths, and each adapter takes its settings from adapters.<name>, as set in the venue config or by adapter/configure. Requires dynamicModules.enabled; by default the module must be a jar name inside the staging directory dynamicModules.dir (no absolute paths or '..'); dynamicModules.anyPath widens this to any filesystem path. Optional sha256 pins the jar content. The live module is not persisted across restarts. Venue-owned: requires admin/adapter/manage on <venue DID>/adapters.

module.description: Jar name inside the staging directory (or a path when anyPath is enabled)

sha256.description: Optional hex SHA-256 the jar must match
